gitCommit.subject: Studio: redesigned itinerary editor (tabs, page content per language, PDF upload, guide)
gitCommit.body:
Studio: redesigned itinerary editor (tabs, page content per language, PDF upload, guide)

- List as cards: cover, status (draft/published/hidden), price, sales; search,
  filter (incl. hidden), duplicate, hide, delete (blocked when it has buyers).
- Editor in seven tabs: basics, page content (every public block per ar/en/id,
  benefit list with icon picker, how-it-works steps, section show/hide/order),
  FAQ, private days, pricing, PDF (drag & drop with progress, what-is-sent per
  language, history, preview/download), preview. Each tab saves only its own
  fields; unsaved-changes warning; «؟ دليل» guide panel per tab (ar/en/id).
- Migration 0049: itineraries.page_content (backfilled to the current order);
  public page reads it with translation fallback; DTO allow-list + leak tests.
- PDF upload: proxyClientMaxBodySize 25mb (proxy cut bodies at 10 MB), clear
  Arabic storage error, one deliveredPdf rule shared with delivery.
- Audit for create/update/duplicate/hide/show/page content/FAQ/upload/delete.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Rhcg1nc6tRTvhEFMLi883G
